title: Crab Derby, 2007 · after
logline: The Monday after the hundred-dollar offer: the 1998 flyer in a cheap plastic frame now, screwed to the wall, four screws. Gully with the screwdriver. Wood asks if that's about the hundred dollars. Gully says it's about the weather.

panels.composition: The wall. The 1998 flyer in a plastic frame. GULLY with a screwdriver, the last screw going in. WOOD. BARNABY.

panels.composition: The framed flyer, close. The other twenty-two, unframed, going on down the wall.
